content: Prompt versioning tools (LangSmith, Langfuse, PromptLayer): version registry with SHA-hash tracking, tags/release labels, side-by-side diff comparison in UI, A/B batch testing with metrics, threaded feedback. Key insight: versioning without evals is just diff tracking - value comes from tying versions to scores. PromptLayer targets non-technical users with visual tools; LangSmith deep observability.
